text_to_image_prompt: Photorealistic wardrobe product image, pure white background, soft studio light, portrait 2:3, no person, skin, body parts, visible mannequin or stand. Entire object fully visible. Brown short sleeve button shirt over crisp white collared shirt with white rolled cuffs; taupe high-waist wide-leg pleated trousers with long button fly; taupe shoes.
original_prompt: Edit this wardrobe product image. REMOVE THE NECKTIE COMPLETELY from inside the shirt collar. The white inner shirt must have its plain white front placket fully visible without any dark fabric triangle or tie. Preserve all other clothing, shoes, empty hollow garment structure and pure white background exactly. No accessories at all. No person or mannequin.
reproduction_note: 根据服装参考生成无人商品展示。遮挡或未展示的细节采用保守补全；文字和品牌细节仅为视觉参考。未进行逐图重新生成相似度验证。
